tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// g.yu thog snying thig sngon 'gro phyi gtor bsngos pas kun tshims bzhugs so//

na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ g.yu thog bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi gsang sgrub las byang sngon 'gro bsdus pa gsar bsgrigs ltar la/ rgyas par spro na rin po che'i snod gsum du dkar gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa dang*/ zan ril drug la dkar mngar dang*/ bgegs gtor dmar zlum g.yas g.yon ri dwags rna ba 'dra ba dang*/ mdun du mtheb ril can sha khrag chang gis bran pa bcas gsum bshams la/ dang po gtsang gtor ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ gis sbyang*/ rdzas rnams mi dmigs stong par gyur// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs su// oṃ zhu lha rdzas gtor ma mchog /zag med bde skyed mkha' mnyam gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+yan+nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyis byin brlab/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mgron rigs spyan drangs gyur// rdor dril 'dzin la/ mgron rnams spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs dgyes par bzhugs// dam tshig dran mdzod ci nus mchod cing bstod// rang rang mthun rdzas bshams bzhes yongs tshims nas// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ dkar phyogs mngon par skyong ba'i dam tshig can// tshangs pa brgya byin phyogs skyong gtsug lag srung*// gza' dang rgyu skar lha klu sde brgyad sogs// gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas// steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khod pa thams cad la// 'dod yon mi zad mchod sbyin gtor ma 'bul// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bar chad kun zhi 'dod don ma lus sgrubs// ya hi gats+tsha/

zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma dang po phyi rol du 'bul/ gnyis pa rigs drug gtor ma ni/ slar yang rang thugs snying rje'i 'od zer gyis// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams bos par gyur// a nṛ su tri pre du sarba satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ satwāḥpū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes mchod/ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngo/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal ba'i gnas yan gyi// 'gro ba sems can skye 'gro ma lus la// bdud rtsi 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bsngos pas// sdug bsngal kun bral bde bas tshims gyur cig /ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes gtor ma phyi rol du bskyal/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam nas/ hūm̐/ nga ni dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ khro rgyal ma lus kun gyi rje// bgegs rigs ma lus bran du khol// tshur shog gtor longs bka' nyon cig /bi nā ya ga sarba bhū te bh+yoḥ sarba pre ta ā kar+sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mgron 'gugs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bhā ra hūm̐/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ sa ma ya na ra kan badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag nas/ hūm̐/ bi nā ya ga khams gsum bdag po dang*// dga' rab dbang phyug sprin sgrol mthu chen sogs// rnal 'byor dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i// log 'dren bgegs kyi rigs gyur thams cad kun// phyogs mtshams nye ring gang nas 'ongs kyang rung*// sngon gyi lan chags bu lon yod na yang*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs bral bar gyis// gdug pa'i sems spongs zhi dul ldan par byos// rang gi lus ngag yid la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba snying nas spongs// gal te bden pa'i bka' las khyod 'da' na// dam tshig nyams nas rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro

/sdig las sdug bsngal dge las bde ba 'byung*// rgyu las 'bras bu bslu med dran gyis la// sgo gsum bag yod sdom la gnas pa dang*// 'di ru ma 'dug rang rang gnas su songs// sarba bhū ta uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas bgegs gtor rgyang ring por dor la/ las gzhung gi bka' bsgo la 'jug go /zhes pa'ang rang gzhung bcos med sor bzhag la cung zad gsal du btang ba po ni gu ṇa'i ming 'dzin no// dge legs 'phel// //
